title: Observability Weekly Notes - 2026-06-01
content:
Week: 2026-06-01 Observability team weekly notes

Attendees: Aisha, Liam, Sophia, Ethan, Maria (SRE)

Summary:
- Focus this week on tracing retention adjustments, dashboard refresh for model-inference latencies, and cost telemetry pipeline fixes for Dedicated nodes.

Standups / Highlights:
- Tracing: Rolled out span-filtering to reduce storage for low-value spans by ~22% in staging. Observed no regressions in distributed traces for host->gpu routing. Next: run 7-day smoke on canary before prod rollout.
- Dashboards: New model-inference-latency dashboard (v2) ready; includes p95/p99 by model type, GPU pool, and request size. Seeking feedback from Serving Runtime team. Widget notes -> need to add free-text filters for model tags.
- Cost telemetry: ETL job for per-model cost attribution failing intermittently when node labels missing. Root cause: k8s node-label sync race (ticket ENG-4523). Hotfix in PR#3789 deployed to staging; monitoring for 24h.
- Alerts/Oncall: Added alert OBS-High-KV-Cache-Miss for KV cache miss rate > 30% sustained 10m. Liam to tune thresholds after 24h.

Meeting Notes:
- Monday sync (2026-05-25): Discussed tracing retention policy options. Agreed to keep high-cardinality spans at 7 days, low-card spans at 3 days with sampling. Action: Aisha to update retention config (ansible) and create rollout playbook. Related Confluence: /display/OBS/Tracing+Rollout
- Wednesday deep-dive (2026-05-27): Dashboards v2 review. Suggested adding a heatmap for tail-latency correlated with batch size. Sophia to prototype.
- Friday review (2026-05-30): Cost telemetry ETL postmortem. Root cause identified and PR merged. Plan to backfill missing attribution for last 48h once hotfix validated.

Action Items:
- Aisha: Draft rollout runbook for tracing retention (due 2026-06-03).
- Liam: Tune OBS-High-KV-Cache-Miss thresholds and review pager docs (due 2026-06-04).
- Sophia: Add heatmap to latency dashboard and share mockups (due 2026-06-05).
- Ethan: Run 7-day canary for span-filtering in staging and report anomalies (due 2026-06-08).
- Maria (SRE): Coordinate cost backfill window with Data Engineering.

Blockers:
- Backfill permission for cost telemetry requires data-eng approval (blocked by data-eng availability next week).
- Some legacy instrumentation emits high-cardinality tags; need a scrub plan before retention rollout.

Metrics / Quick numbers:
- Tracing storage delta (staging): -22% after span-filtering
- Model-inference p95 (last 24h): 112ms; p99: 420ms (gpu-pool-a)
- Cost telemetry failure rate (ETL): 8% -> after hotfix currently 0% in staging

Links:
- Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/model-inference-latency
- Tracing rollout doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Tracing+Rollout
- Jira: ENG-4523
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3789

Notes / Misc:
- Consider adding sampling tags to runtime SDK to help classify low-value spans.
- We should run a quick cost impact analysis once the backfill completes to confirm per-model charge correctness.

Next meeting: Weekly Observability sync - 2026-06-08 10:00 PT (standup style).
